LESSON: READING 2.2.1 READING FLUENCY

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.2: Reading 2.2.1 Reading Fluency
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 2.2.1 Reading Fluency, part of Strand 2 in Grade 5 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: How does speed affect fluency in reading? 2. Why should we be alert on weather changes?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. conduct a reader’s theatre to read a simple passage aloud based on the theme,

2. identify instances of change in intonation from the texts read,

3. work with peers to read a text at varying speeds and with accuracy,

4. team up with peers to play a language speed reading game,

5. discuss on the best and most accurate speed for reading,

6. conduct a reading contest with peers to practice reading fluently, at the right speed and with correct intonation,

7. read a passage independently and answer comprehension questions. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. conduct a reader’s theatre to read a simple passage aloud based on the theme,
2. identify instances of change in intonation from the texts read,
3. work with peers to read a text at varying speeds and with accuracy,
4. team up with peers to play a language speed reading game,
5. discuss on the best and most accurate speed for reading,
6. conduct a reading contest with peers to practice reading fluently, at the right speed and with correct intonation,
7. read a passage independently and answer comprehension questions. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 2.2.1 Reading Fluency together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learning to Learn: This is promoted as the learner builds on their learning experience when conducting a reading contest

to practice reading fluently, at the right speed and with correct intonation.

• Self-efficacy: This is enhanced as the learner shows defining personal skills when reading a text at varying speeds and

with accuracy.

Values:
• Responsibility: This is enhanced as the learner cooperates with peers to play a language speed reading game.

• Love: This is promoted as the learner listens and appreciates the contribution of peers as they discuss on the best and most

accurate speed for reading.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Environmental awareness: This is promoted as the learner interacts with texts on the environment in class.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner can relate the concept on reading fluency through appropriate speed to similar concepts in English.
